subject: Leaf Blower Ordinance
overview: The Committee of the Whole met to review and consider amendments to a proposed leaf blower ordinance (Paper 21-057). Following discussion and public comment, the committee approved several text amendments and voted to report the draft ordinance out of committee as amended.

items.title: Leaf Blower Ordinance Revision (Paper 21-057)
items.summary: The committee reviewed updated draft language regulating gas and electric leaf blowers, including seasonal restrictions, commercial operational plans, and a phased transition away from gas-powered equipment. Following public testimony regarding fiscal, operational, and environmental impacts, the committee adopted several proposed amendments and voted to report the paper out of committee as amended.
